searchText: MSRP $212,069 New 2026 Forest River FR3 Model 35DS Bunk Model. This RV measures approximately 35 feet 6 inches in length and features 2 slide outs, theater seats, large living area, Residential refrigerator and a king size bed. The FR3 crossover motorhome combines the family friendly livability and affordability of an easy to drive Class C motorhome with the space, convenience, and styling of a Class A motorhome. This beautiful new motorhome also features the new Ford chassis with 7.3L PFI V-8, a 6-speed TorqShift® automatic transmission. This RV features the optional combination washer/dryer, theater seats and power package. A few of the standard features the beautiful FR3 boasts include slide room topper awnings, power patio awning with LED light strip, 4-point hydraulic leveling jacks, LED lighting throughout unit, exterior shower, power front sun shade, 6KW generator, 3 burner cook top with oven and flush mount stove cover and so much more.
